title: Gemba Connect
description: A scalable low-code platform built with Angular and a Java-based backend, using a metadata-driven approach to support configurable business applications and workflows.
shortDescription: Configurable enterprise workflows and metadata-driven operations.
highlights: Built configurable workflow experiences using metadata-driven patterns and reusable business components.
Created dynamic forms and data-driven interfaces across inventory, purchase, sales, and logistics flows.
Worked across configurable data models, workflow definitions, dynamic forms, and role-based enterprise operations.

title: Kenzol – Web & Mobile ERP Application
description: An Angular and Ionic manufacturing ERP application supporting workflows from raw-material procurement through production and final dispatch.
shortDescription: Manufacturing ERP workflows across web and mobile interfaces.
highlights: Developed ERP-focused interfaces for manufacturing operations, inventory tracking, and production planning.
Worked with BOM-based planning and logistics-facing workflows across multi-role user journeys.
Connected responsive web and mobile experiences to REST API workflows for operational clarity.

title: Quality Management App
description: A React Native manufacturing quality app for inward, in-process, and final inspections, real-time dashboards, defect tracking, and memo management.
shortDescription: Inspection workflows and defect tracking for quality operations.
highlights: Implemented inspection workflows with dynamic forms, image upload, role-based access, and operational dashboards.
Worked across inward, in-process, and final inspections with defect tracking and memo management.
Supported Excel-based bulk import workflows for faster operational data entry.

title: Beacon — E-learning & Education Management Platform
description: An Angular and Ionic-based e-learning and education management platform with role-based access, where the same connected platform provides different data and workflows based on the authenticated user's login and assigned access.
shortDescription: One connected education platform with role-specific learning and academic workflows.
highlights: Role-based experience: the same platform dynamically presents relevant data and functionality based on the authenticated user's login and assigned access.
Parent access includes exam details, academic performance, family-linked student information, and fee-related information according to assigned access.
Student access includes virtual examinations, digital learning content, and interactive reading and annotation workflows.
Integrated an interactive Canvas-based reading and annotation experience supporting highlighting, borders, drawing, and other document interactions across touch, stylus, and laptop/PC use.
Implemented Google Sign-In, Apple Sign-In, and fingerprint authentication for cross-platform mobile workflows.

title: Coding IDE
description: A React frontend and Node.js backend for web-based code execution, authentication, personalized access, and real-time execution workflows.
shortDescription: Real-time coding workflows with authentication and personalized access.
highlights: Worked on coding workflow experiences with interactive execution and personalized access control.
Integrated authentication and access-aware user flows for secure development use cases.
Contributed to a focused interface for coding and evaluation activities with real-time execution workflows.

title: Agridashboard – Web and Mobile Application
description: An Angular web and Ionic mobile application for weather, soil, and crop data with alerts, offline access/caching, push notifications, and predictive analytics.
shortDescription: Agricultural monitoring, alerts, and operational dashboards for field data.
highlights: Built dashboards and alerting workflows for weather, soil, and crop monitoring use cases.
Delivered field-friendly mobile experiences with offline access/caching, push notifications, and mobile alerts.
Supported predictive analytics and satellite imagery workflows alongside ongoing maintenance for live agricultural data experiences.
